LanguageData.MultistackStorageTooltip: Allow multiple stacks in one cell.\nSimilar items may still be restricted by limit rules.
LanguageData.SimilarStackLimitDefaultTooltip: The stack limit slider sets the limit for the whole storage zone or building.
LanguageData.SimilarStackLimitDisabledTooltip: The stack limit slider sets the limit per stockpile cell or per stack slot in a building. There is no cap on how many stacks you can have beyond available cells or free storage slots.
LanguageData.SimilarStackLimitTooltip: The stack limit slider sets the limit per stockpile cell or per stack slot in a building. This storage may contain at most {COUNT} separate stacks of this item.
